$comment: CANONICAL PRICE LIST. This file is the single pricing authority for Rachbase.
It is consumed by:
- packages/billing/src/catalog/index.js  (server-side pricing; the ONLY thing
permitted to decide what a cart costs)
- packages/ui/src/lib/catalog.ts         (typed re-export for display)
Before this file existed the catalog was copy-pasted into four places and had
already drifted: Managed PostgreSQL was $200 on the marketing page and $100 in
the server's SERVICE_PRICES, and five of eight services were missing server-side
entirely so they could not be ordered.
All prices are INTEGER CENTS. Never add a decimal price to this file.
Bundle savings are COMPUTED from contents — do not add an originalPrice field.

$comment: Shared managed-container pricing (compute_target='shared'). GEO-BASED: prices are NATIVE
per region, NOT a currency-pegged conversion. `regions` is the authority — one block per
billing currency (USD = Rest-of-World, INR = India). Region is resolved from the tenant's
billing address (India/GST -> INR, else USD); the client never picks it.
Two subscription tiers on both regions: starter (includes 1 nano container), pro (includes 3).
Each container beyond the allowance = region.container_cents. Compute size is a per-container
ADD-ON delta on top of the container fee (nano +0). Billing is PER SERVICE (replicas do not
change price). India amounts are ex-GST (18% GST added at checkout).
RoW  ($): Starter $10, Pro $30, +container $10, micro +$10, small +$20.
India (INR, +GST): Starter Rs500, Pro Rs1,500, +container Rs500, micro +Rs400, small +Rs800.
Top-level base_cents/container_cents + compute_sizes.delta_cents mirror the USD region for
back-compat/display defaults; `tiers` holds region-independent labels + included allowance.

footnotes: Daily DB backups run at pre-decided times with a 7-day retention period.
On-demand Postgres backups require a request at least 24 hours in advance. Fixed 30-day retention.
VM snapshot retention is 7 days by default. Contact the Cloud Infra/Ops team for higher retention.
